verdict.rationale: dLocal documents a Payment Links product that lets merchants collect payments and "go to market in no time" with "no integration" required, which is the core of the no-code story. The docs also describe a payments list filterable by date range, and a merchant dashboard for tracking transactions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that links are created from the dashboard UI, detail on sharing the link (URL/QR distribution), evidence that a new founder can start selling immediately without lengthy onboarding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
